Card Q&A.a: It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.
Card Q&A.q: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card is in the breeding area and would digivolve into a Digimon card with [Pulsemon] in its text or the [SEEKERS] trait?
Can I activate this card’s inherited effect even if my opponent's Digimon and the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards are deleted at the same timing?

Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with [Pulsemon] in its text or the [SEEKERS] trait, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, gain 1 memory.
